description: NaAlBr₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form distorted NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent AlBr₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent AlBr₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.10 Å. Al³⁺ is bonded to four Br¹⁻ atoms to form AlBr₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids and edges with two equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Al-Br bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.32 Å. There are three inequivalent Br¹⁻ sites. In the first Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom. In the second Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom. In the third Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom.
